1479-5700-5701-6763-8338.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6763-8338.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2079-4770-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-8201.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

529-4927-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2577-4826-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4826-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4677-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-4677-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-3899-6972--112.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
284-3899-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1895-4399-4770-5070.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-5070.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

851-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
851-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
851-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Adrix and Nev.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Adrix and Nev.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-5477-6321-6791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-6791.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4871-5231-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4871-5231-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding {R}{R}{R}
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2585-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 5.
2585-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by paying {4}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
2585-3918-4306.notes: Once you have extra mana, Grim Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

933-2388-2750-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
933-2388-2750-6587.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

891-5231-5617.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1558-3875-4231-4321-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-4321-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1659-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

930-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-5921-5967-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-5921-5967-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-5921-5967-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

147-2511-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

1978-2734-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-2734-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-997-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5365-6010.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
5365-6010.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis's second ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Repeat from step 2.
5365-6010.notes: This combo can create a mandatory infinite loop if you control no other creatures. To stop the loop, place a counter on another creature or remove Lonis / Builder's Talent from the battlefield.

238-5256-5756.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

2201-2558-4779-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1003-5220-5256-5683.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

372-2705-4344.description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Suspension Field to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Suspension Field and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Lumbering Battlement to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

224-2174-3470-4967.notablePrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
224-2174-3470-4967.description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Repeat.

1409-3758-5104.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ramirez.
Your life total is at least three.
1409-3758-5104.description:
Activate Ramirez by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Ramirez enters the battlelfield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Ramirez trigger, creating two Treasure tokens and causing you to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ramirez.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Nadier's Nightblade triggers twice, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Repeat.

950-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3478-4222.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
